dedupe_keys.name: a coupling strategy to run daily cycle simulations of thermally stratified flows over forests

description: Matias Avila and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented CFD coupling represents forest-canopy effects with canopy-top radiative flux and a geostrophic-gradient forcing. The described evaluation uses Ryningsnas and addresses diurnal atmospheric behaviour relevant to forested wind-energy sites. Application to more complex terrain is stated as a future extension and is not treated as demonstrated coverage. The model supplies a particular atmospheric-flow representation for turbine inflow assessment; it does not release an independent new observational campaign. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
